about.purpose: Append-only log of every Closer prediction. Locked fields never change after logging; only result fields are filled in when the game ends.
about.integrity: Each entry's hash covers its locked fields plus the previous entry's hash (SHA-256 chain). tools/verify-log.ps1 and the website both recompute it; GitHub runs the check on every change.

sources.manual: Picked by hand. No model probability.
sources.experimental: Untested model output. Not yet logged (needs a backend).
sources.validated: Model with a published backtest on unseen past seasons. None yet.

about.migration: 2026-11-21: converted from the first version of this log. Prices that were not recorded when picked are null instead of an assumed -110; 'strength' renamed 'tier' (a manual rating, not a probability); entries whose game had started before the log's first commit are flagged loggedAfterStart and left out of verified stats.
about.history: Fresh record started 2026-11-22. The 55 starter picks written during the original app build were never checked against real data, so the CEO removed them before the site went public. They are kept unchanged, hash chain intact, in data/archive/starter-picks-2026-11-20.json. Every pick from here on goes through tools/add-pick.ps1, which checks it against real numbers first.

engineChanges.change: Spread projections fixed. Earlier engine versions halved the difference between the two teams' average margins, which tilted spread picks toward underdogs. Picks E0001-E0008 were made under the old rule and stay in the record unchanged; totals were not affected.

reset.reason: Starter picks were never checked against real data; removed before the site went public (CEO decision).
